title: Halberd Mills: a cooperative that outlasted the trade
text: Halberd Mills Cooperative was founded in 1998 by a group of hand-weavers in Cawden Vale, and it has produced wool blankets there ever since. Membership has grown steadily, and the cooperative counts just over two hundred members this year, most of them working from home looms. In 2015 its ridge-pattern blanket took the Fenmoor design award, the first time a cooperative rather than a mill had won it.
notes: Set B. Trade-press piece, the most confident source in the set. Carries no anniversary figure in the title on purpose: a number there would imply a founding year and leak a fourth answer into a question whose answer key has three.
